drafter_scope_passage.text: // Root filleting remains PROSE: the joined boolean is not an exact prism
// payload, which decad.Fillet requires. A chorded replacement changes the
// cylindrical-face radius selection and cannot prove that selected edge set.
// Completed-gear chamfer remains PROSE: decad.Chamfer supports lateral edges,
// and refuses the end-cap edges explicitly required here. A lateral chamfer
// would prove a different operation. Bore-after-fillet therefore proves the
// through-cut on the available unfilleted joined geometry; it does not prove
// Fusion's final fillet/chamfer face topology or their integration.

operator_assessment: Fillet/chamfer and their integration with bore are outside the submitted proof coverage. Gate acceptance cannot establish no-dropped-assertions by itself.
